title: Quick sort
summary: Partition around a pivot so smaller values come first, then sort each side recursively.

narration.text: Positions {lo} to {hi} hold at most one value: nothing to sort.
Nothing to do for this part.
Use the last value of this part, {pivot}, as the pivot.
Values smaller than the pivot will gather at the front, starting at position {p}.
Every value in this part has been compared with the pivot.
{arr[k]} < {pivot}: it belongs before the pivot, so swap it into position {p}.
{arr[k]} ≥ {pivot}: leave it on the right side.
The next smaller value will go to position {p}.
Swap the pivot into position {p}, its final place: everything left of it is smaller.
The part left of the pivot is now sorted.
The part right of the pivot is now sorted.
